create_BaselineAgent: create a BaselineAgent with SAC, transition model, and configurable decoder types for RL training
run_select_action: run the BaselineAgent select_action method to get a deterministic action from an observation
run_sample_action: run the BaselineAgent sample_action method to sample a stochastic action from the policy
run_update: run the BaselineAgent update method to perform one training step using a replay buffer sample
run_save_load: run the BaselineAgent save and load methods to persist and restore actor, critic, and decoder weights
